Dear MAYA OKAFOR,

This is an update on your Missing Mail Search Request, submitted November 12, 2026.

Search Request Number: MMS-3381906
Tracking Number: 9400111899223197428490
Mail Class: USPS Ground Advantage

According to our records, this item was delivered on November 7, 2026 in TUCSON, AZ 85705. The delivery address recorded for this item does not match the address you provided on your search request (SAN JOSE, CA 95131).

Because the package was scanned as delivered at a different address, it was most likely addressed to that location by the sender. We are unable to redirect or retrieve an item once it has been delivered. We recommend that you contact the sender (the shipper who created the label) to confirm the shipping address they used, and pursue a refund or replacement through your merchant or payment provider.

Your search request will remain open for 15 days in case any new information becomes available.

Thank you,
USPS Missing Mail Team

Subject: Re: ugh the dress

omg Tucson?? that's so weird. ok so DON'T close the case even if the shop emails you being all apologetic. I made that mistake once with a pair of boots and then they ghosted me and I couldn't reopen it.

What worked for me last year (different thing, a lamp from some random site): I waited like a week for the seller to respond in the case, they didn't, so I hit "escalate to claim" and attached the tracking screenshot showing it went to the wrong city. PayPal refunded me in about 10 days. Not guaranteed obviously but the wrong-state thing is pretty clear cut.

Your deadline is Dec 1 right? Put it in your calendar for like the 24th so you don't forget over Thanksgiving lol

Also coffee this week? I'm free Wed after 4

p.

From: Rosa Medina <rosamedina.tia@yahoo.com>
To: maya.okafor@gmail.com
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 12:51:30 -0800
Subject: Lo del vestido

Hola mija,

Tu mamá me contó lo del vestido que nunca te llegó. Qué coraje. A mí me pasó algo parecido con unos zapatos el año pasado y te cuento lo que aprendí:

1. No cierres el caso en PayPal aunque la tienda te prometa que te va a devolver el dinero por fuera. Que todo sea dentro de PayPal.
2. Si la tienda no te contesta, hay que "escalar" el caso a reclamo antes de la fecha límite. Tu mamá dice que el tuyo se cierra solo el 1 de diciembre si no lo escalas, así que no lo dejes para el último día.
3. Guarda la captura del rastreo donde dice que se entregó en Tucson. Eso es la prueba de que no llegó a tu casa en San José.

A mí al final sí me hicieron el reembolso, pero tardó como dos semanas después de escalarlo. Ten paciencia.

Te quiero mucho. ¿Vienes el Día de Acción de Gracias?

Besos,
Tía Rosa
